definition: The **ILO** (1919, League of Nations; now a UN specialised agency) promotes social justice through **international labour standards**. It uses a **tripartite** structure (governments, employers, workers). **Conventions** (binding when ratified) and **Recommendations** shape national laws—including India’s labour codes, factory safety, child labour, and freedom of association norms.

sections: Art. 51(c) — foster respect for international law and treaty obligations
